heading: OPD queue
description: Today's tokens at this hospital, by department and doctor, in the order they are called.

live.retrying: Reconnecting. Meanwhile the queue refreshes every {{seconds}} seconds.
live.off: Live updates are not available. The queue refreshes every {{seconds}} seconds.

done.recalled: Token {{number}}, {{patient}}, is back in the queue.

refused.changed: Someone else changed this token first. The queue shows it as it is now.
refused.empty: Nobody is waiting for this doctor.

cancelPanel.heading: Cancel token {{number}}, {{patient}}
cancelPanel.description: A cancelled token leaves the queue for good and its number is not used again. The patient can be given a new token.
cancelPanel.noteRequired: Say why, when the reason is "Other".

refused.alreadyQueued: This patient already has a token in this department today.
refused.alreadyCheckedIn: This appointment was checked in at another desk. See the queue.
refused.notToday: Only today's appointments can be checked in.
refused.notScheduled: This appointment is no longer scheduled.
refused.unavailable: This appointment cannot be checked in here. Ask an administrator.

issue.heading: Issue a token
issue.description: Put a patient who has walked in into today's queue of a department.
issue.askedNotFound: The patient you came from could not be loaded. Find them below.
issue.doctorHint: Leave as any doctor to let the first doctor free in the department call the patient.
issue.priorityHint: A token with a priority is called ahead of the others.

refused.alreadyQueued: This patient already has a token in this department today.
refused.doctorNotInDepartment: That doctor is not in this department any more. Choose again.
refused.unknownPatient: That patient cannot be found at this hospital.

unavailable.departments: Issuing a token needs departments, which you cannot see here. Ask an administrator.
unavailable.patients: Issuing a token needs finding a patient, which you cannot do here. Ask an administrator.

display.heading: Waiting-room display
display.description: Token numbers and where to go, for a screen the waiting patients can see. It shows no names.
